P Wave:

- \</= 0.12sec
- PR Interval: \</= 0.12-0.2 sec
- QRS: \< 0.12sec
- QT Interval: QTc (corrected four HR) \<440ms men 460ms women  
- ST Segment

PR Interval:

- The PR interval is the period of time between the start of depolarisation of the atria to the start of depolarisation of the ventricles.
- The interval reflects the conduction through the AV node 
- Normal is between 0.12-0.2sec 
- \<0.12sec indicates pre-excitation or junctional rhythm

Factors influencing PR interval:

- Autonomic innervation, PNS ↑conduction time / PR interval, SNS ↓PR interval 
- Electrolyte disturbances 
- Hypoxia/hypothermia 
- Cardiac abnormalities: 
  - Conductance system degeneration
  - Infarction/ischaemia 
- Drugs:
  - B Blockers
  - Sympathomimetics 
  - Digoxin 
  - Ca Channel Blockers
